purpose: Research reference for native algorithmic reverb; not playable or verified Studio presets
disclaimer: Facility names identify acoustic inspirations, not affiliations or licensing. RT values are from the cited source under its documented circumstances. Published, reported, model-derived and historical measurements must not be equated. Unknown RT is intentionally omitted. Do not present any row as a calibrated reproduction.
